normalize_quaternion_positive_w: normalize a quaternion to have a positive leading scalar w component
fix_quaternion_sign: fix the sign of a quaternion so its w component is non-negative
canonicalize_quat: canonicalize a wxyz quaternion by ensuring the leading scalar is positive
review_positive_leading_quat: review the positive_leading_quat function that normalizes quaternion sign for pose utilities
test_positive_leading_quat: test the positive_leading_quat function with quaternions that have negative w components
